title: Scenario Kernel Specification
description: Root language-neutral specification manifest for the Scenario Kernel contract family.

outcomeMeaning.description: Outcome denotes the promised resulting reality. Outcome data represents observable state that can establish whether that experience became true.

bindingAuthority.description: A scenario-transition's bindingAuthorityId is optional only when its from.contractId and to.contractId resolve to the identical contract (a direct pass-through). Any transition that projects, transforms, or reshapes data across distinct contracts must supply a bindingAuthorityId resolving to an admitted binding authority. Not structurally enforceable in portable JSON Schema — requires cross-document contract-identity resolution, which draft 2020-12 has no cross-property equality keyword for. Enforced at the semantic-authority/conformance layer; see kernel/semantic-authority/transitions/binding-authority.semantic-authority.json.
